origin.name: Warrior Priest
origin.Description: Relying on their physical prowess, these people are all trained fighters, although they are not necessarily from the military.

weapon.name: Fat Pistol
weapon.Description: Fat, Ugly, and excessively bulky. The Pistol Is designed to be cheap, and for testing.

journal.name: Where am I
journal.Description: You awaken to find yourself aboard a large astrological structure floating In the depths of Deep Space. Perhaps It is time to find where you are?
